presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: The lens enlarges Party A's reply pocket: 'Reply received · Day 3 (as supplied)' becomes 'Reply pending (as supplied)'; the slip leaves the pocket and its neutral empty slot shows; back in context the calendar glyph leaves too and a Δ marker and before/after note stay.

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: the lens enlarges the calendar cells; the supplied reply day changes from Day 3 to Day 4 and the glyph slides to the other day's slot (the slip stays in the pocket). Different parties and documents.

presets.name: long-labels-stress
presets.description: Near-maximum lengths: long names and roles, references, letter contents, reply slip, date line, seven day labels, stage captions, prop labels, before/after values, context caption and marker label. coordinator decision 2026-09-26 (standing stress rule, AUTHORING item 20): stress lengths capped to the longest values found to fit every ratio at >= 16 px without scaling: capped the "sent" and "delivered" stage captions (40→32, 45→36 characters); every field stays longer than the baseline and all counts are kept. Measured: near-maximum lengths make the joint sent→delivered tag cover the reply tag at rest in 1:1 (text column fallback, no room for a legend entry); tried: column fallback, joint tag, numbered legend.
